responsibility: Declares the tree-oriented layer of GCC’s spelling-suggestion subsystem. It exposes identifier-based edit-distance and closest-match routines and provides the edit_distance_traits specialization for tree identifiers, allowing the generic best_match template from spellcheck.h to work directly with IDENTIFIER_NODE values.
same_name_distinction: Header for the tree-specific spellcheck layer: it declares the identifier-oriented edit-distance and closest-match APIs and specializes edit_distance_traits<tree>, while spellcheck-tree.cc contains the executable matching logic over IDENTIFIER_NODE values.
